messages.content: 想像你是一位在實驗室工作的科學家。你手上有一個質量為10公斤、體積為2立方公尺的物質。你想要計算這個物質的密度，單位為公斤/立方公尺。實驗結束後，你想要放鬆一下，於是決定做一些繪畫。你決定混合兩種主要顏色，紅色和藍色。但是，你希望混合後的顏色具有70%的亮度。之後，你又有另一個質量為5公斤、體積為1立方公尺的物質。你也想要計算這個物質的密度，但這次單位為克/立方公分。最後，你決定混合另一組主要顏色，黃色和藍色，但是你希望混合後的顏色具有30%的亮度。你能計算出密度並相應地混合顏色嗎？

function.name: calculate_density
function.description: Calculate the density of a substance based on its mass and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kilograms.

volume.description: The volume of the substance in cubic meters.

unit.description: The unit of density. Default is kg/m³

function.name: mix_paint_color
function.description: Combine two primary paint colors and adjust the resulting color's lightness level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

color1.description: The first primary color to be mixed.

color2.description: The second primary color to be mixed.

lightness.description: The desired lightness level of the resulting color in percentage. The default level is set to 50%.

First calculation: mass=10 kg, volume=2 m^3, unit default kg/m^3. So density = 10 / 2 = 5 kg/m^3.

Second calculation: mass=5 kg, volume=1 m^3, but unit requested is g/cm^3. We need to convert. 1 kg = 1000 g. 1 m^3 = 1e6 cm^3. So density in g/cm^3 = (5*1000)/(1e6) = 5000/1e6 = 0.005 g/cm^3.

Alternatively we can use the function with unit parameter "g/cm^3". But the function likely expects unit string; we can pass "g/cm^3" and it will compute accordingly? If we want g/cm^3, we can convert mass to grams: 5000 g, volume to cm^3: 1e6 cm^3. Then density = 5000/1e6 = 0.005 g/cm^3. So we can call calculate_density with mass=5, volume=1, unit="g/cm^3"? That would produce 5/1 = 5? No, because the function might not convert. But we can pass mass=5, volume=1, unit="g/cm^3" and expect it to output 5? That seems wrong. So better to convert manually before calling. But the instructions say "Calculate the density of a substance based on its mass and volume." The function likely returns density in the specified unit. But we don't know how it handles conversion. Let's assume it does conversion: if unit is "g/cm^3", it will convert mass from kg to g and volume from m^3 to cm^3. So we can call with mass=5, volume=1, unit="g/cm^3".

Now mixing colors: first mix red and blue with lightness 70%. Second mix yellow and blue with lightness 30%.
